issues.detail: The Greek 'τη σπουδη' (the diligence) is the direct object of the implied verb 'μη' (do not [be]). The Vietnamese translation 'Chớ biếng nhác' (Do not be lazy) changes the grammatical structure from 'do not [lack] diligence' to a general prohibition against laziness. More importantly, 'τω καιρω' means 'in due season/time,' which is omitted in the Vietnamese translation.
